title: Hatari – Online Atari ST/STE/TT/Falcon Emulator
summary: Hatari is an online emulator that runs Atari ST/STE/TT/Falcon systems directly in the browser, allowing users to experience classic Atari software without needing original hardware.
problem_solved: Enables users to run vintage Atari software and games without requiring original hardware or local installation.
why_valuable: Preserves retro computing history and provides easy access to classic Atari software for preservation, education, and nostalgia purposes.
